HomePage.clientsTitle: Engineering trusted on demanding operational programs
HomePage.clientsFootnote: We apply that same rigor across our products — from Commercium for local commerce to Clinic, FootX Scheduler, and Tabula for healthcare teams.
HomePage.productsSectionIntro: Commercium helps local retailers sell online; Clinic, FootX Scheduler, and Tabula serve clinical and scheduling workflows — all built to stay dependable under pressure.

HomePage.tabulaCardDesc: Smart medical scheduling for modern practices — centralize agendas by professional and location, cut no-shows with confirmations, and keep patients and availability organized.

HomePage.stackUnifiedDesc: Active technologies across our product ecosystem, without splitting by project.
HomePage.whyIntro: Engineering discipline and operational realism — without theatrics.
HomePage.why1Desc: Software aligned to real processes: handoffs, exceptions, regulations, and the details that matter on the ground.
HomePage.why2Desc: Interfaces and data models that stay legible as scope grows — so teams are not buried in noise.
HomePage.why3Desc: Foundations that can extend with integrations, volume, and new capabilities over time.
HomePage.why4Desc: Respectful of staff, operators, and the people who use the software every day — precise where it counts, calm where it helps.

AboutPage.p1: {name} is a product-oriented software company. A human founder owns the vision, trade-offs, and accountability; AI agents act as amplifiers in the workshop—helping draft code, explore designs, and stress-test ideas. What we ship still has to meet the same bar: systems that combine <m1>technical precision</m1>, <m2>usability</m2>, and <m3>long-term maintainability</m3> — so the software you rely on today can still make sense years from now.
AboutPage.p2: Our products span local commerce with Commercium and healthcare tools like Clinic, FootX Scheduler, and Tabula — structured information, clear workflows, and software that holds up in real operations.
AboutPage.p3: We list the AI products we build with on this page because transparency matters. We avoid hype and overstated claims; we prefer calm interfaces, explicit data models, and software that earns trust through consistency — built to evolve alongside your organization.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Custom software, product strategy, and automation for complex business realities.
services.intro: Realitas Infinitas builds custom software for complex realities — combining engineering, product thinking, and business automation to help companies create smarter, scalable digital systems.
services.item1Desc: We design and build custom web applications, internal platforms, APIs, dashboards, and business systems tailored to complex operational needs.
services.item2Desc: We develop software solutions for healthcare workflows, including patient registration, scheduling, eligibility, insurance discovery, estimations, payments, claims, and revenue cycle automation.
services.item3Desc: We help transform ideas into clear, buildable products through MVP planning, system architecture, feature definition, and technical decision-making.
services.item4Desc: We automate repetitive workflows, data exchange, reporting, integrations, and operational processes to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
services.item5Desc: We help companies improve legacy systems, modernize architectures, migrate workflows, and connect existing platforms through reliable integrations.
services.item6Desc: We provide technical guidance for small teams and growing companies, bridging the gap between business goals and software execution.

Leadership.title: Leadership
Leadership.intro: Direction and accountability stay human. Alongside that, we use AI agents deliberately—where they speed up iteration, surface alternatives, and keep the codebase moving—while a senior engineer reviews every meaningful change. Below is the founder profile, followed by the AI tools that sit closest to our day-to-day build.
Leadership.bioP1: Facundo Alvez is a software engineer with over a decade of experience building healthcare technology solutions for the U.S. market. His work spans software development, product strategy, integrations, automation, revenue cycle workflows, and business-critical systems.
Leadership.bioP2: As founder of Realitas Infinitas, he focuses on creating practical, reliable software for complex operational environments.
Leadership.highlight2: Healthcare technology and revenue cycle experience
Leadership.highlight5: Practical software for complex real-world problems
Leadership.aiPartnersIntro: These are not people and they do not replace judgment—but they are part of the team in the same way a compiler or a test suite is: tools we choose, name, and hold to a quality bar.
Leadership.cursorBio: Cursor is where most of this repository lives day to day: multi-file edits, refactors, terminal-aware agents, and context pulled from the codebase so changes stay coherent. It is the cockpit for turning intent into commits—always reviewed, always owned by a human before anything reaches production.
Leadership.chatgptBio: ChatGPT helps us think in prose—clarifying requirements, tightening copy across locales, comparing trade-offs, and sanity-checking explanations before they meet customers. It is a conversational layer on top of domain knowledge we already carry; it does not decide what we ship.

ClinicPage.heroTitle: A clean foundation for patient registration and clinical records.
ClinicPage.feat1Desc: Capture new patients with consistent fields and a clear entry path into your practice.
ClinicPage.feat2Desc: Maintain patient identity and demographic detail in one structured profile.
ClinicPage.feat3Desc: Document history over time so context stays available when it matters.
ClinicPage.feat4Desc: Organize clinical notes and records in a calm, scannable structure.
ClinicPage.feat5Desc: Information is grouped logically — less hunting, fewer inconsistent snapshots.
ClinicPage.feat6Desc: A foundation that can connect to other systems when you are ready to extend.
ClinicPage.workflowSubtitle: A straightforward sequence you can adapt to your practice.
ClinicPage.audienceBody: Clinic is intended for independent healthcare professionals, small clinics, and medical practices that need a more organized way to manage patient information — without adopting an overloaded suite on day one.
ClinicPage.ctaDescription: If you are evaluating tools for your practice or exploring a partnership, we would like to hear from you.

clinicProduct.shortDescription: Patient registration, medical records, and operational workflows for healthcare teams — clarity and reliability by design.

footxProduct.shortDescription: Study-based reminders with multi-practice sync, eligibility stages, and controlled exclusions for imaging follow-up.

tabulaProduct.shortDescription: Medical scheduling by professional and location, with confirmations, patient organization, and clearer control over the agenda.

commerciumProduct.shortDescription: Multi-tenant online commerce for local retailers — storefront, backoffice, catalog import, Mercado Pago, and pickup orders.

TabulaPage.heroTitle: Smart medical scheduling for modern healthcare practices.
TabulaPage.feat1Desc: See appointments by professional, specialty, and location in one place — less calendar chaos.
TabulaPage.feat2Desc: Confirmations and reminders that reduce missed visits and idle slots.
TabulaPage.feat3Desc: Appointment history, coverage, and contact details ready when your team needs them.
TabulaPage.feat4Desc: Pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed — policies and availability that stay explicit.
TabulaPage.feat5Desc: Weekly blocks per specialist so the schedule matches how your practice actually works.
TabulaPage.feat6Desc: Prepared for messaging, payments, and Clinic when you are ready to extend the stack.
TabulaPage.workflowSubtitle: A practical sequence for getting a practice agenda running.
TabulaPage.workflowStep1: Configure your clinic — professionals, locations, and appointment lengths
TabulaPage.workflowStep3: Book, confirm, and follow appointments in real time
TabulaPage.workflowStep4: Keep patients and coverage details organized
TabulaPage.workflowStep5: Extend with messaging or payments when you need them
TabulaPage.audienceBody: Tabula suits clinics, doctors, and healthcare teams that need clarity, speed, and control over their agendas — without adopting an overloaded suite on day one.
TabulaPage.ctaDescription: If you are evaluating medical scheduling tools or exploring a partnership, we would like to hear from you.

CommerciumPage.heroTitle: Digital solutions for local retailers who want to sell online.
CommerciumPage.feat1Desc: Each retailer gets a multi-tenant storefront where customers browse, pay, and prepare pickup orders.
CommerciumPage.feat2Desc: Operate catalog, orders, promotions, and users from a dedicated admin for the commerce team.
CommerciumPage.feat3Desc: Bring products in from spreadsheets with preview, publish, and reporting — without rebuilding the catalog by hand.
CommerciumPage.feat4Desc: Suggested images stay pending until approved; products without photos use a professional placeholder.
CommerciumPage.feat5Desc: Payments are created on the backend and confirmed by webhook — each commerce connects its own account.
CommerciumPage.feat6Desc: Online payment with in-store pickup workflows designed for local retailers and their customers.
CommerciumPage.workflowSubtitle: A practical sequence from catalog to paid pickup order.
CommerciumPage.workflowStep1: Provision the merchant tenant and storefront
CommerciumPage.workflowStep2: Import or manage the catalog and approve product images
CommerciumPage.workflowStep3: Customers shop online and pay with Mercado Pago
CommerciumPage.workflowStep4: The store prepares the order for pickup
CommerciumPage.workflowStep5: Admins maintain users, promotions, and operational settings
CommerciumPage.audienceBody: Commercium is built for local retailers — like neighborhood markets and specialty shops — that need a reliable online channel without building a custom e-commerce stack from scratch.
CommerciumPage.ctaDescription: If you are evaluating online commerce for a local retailer or exploring a partnership, we would like to hear from you.

FootxSchedulerPage.heroTitle: Operational clarity for study follow-up and staged reminders.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat1Desc: Connect data sources and sync patient and study snapshots into application storage for ongoing eligibility.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat2Desc: Separate tenants so each practice sees its own patients, batches, and configuration without cross-noise.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat3Desc: Compute who qualifies for reminder stages from study timing and configured offsets — fewer manual spreadsheets.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat4Desc: Staff can review lists and exclude specific patients or stages when reality diverges from the default rules.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat5Desc: Browse patient lists and drill into detail with filters aligned to how teams actually triage follow-up.
FootxSchedulerPage.feat6Desc: Admin and staff roles with password reset flows delivered through transactional email channels.
FootxSchedulerPage.workflowSubtitle: A practical sequence teams run after imaging studies.
FootxSchedulerPage.workflowStep1: Attach or upload the source database
FootxSchedulerPage.workflowStep2: Sync patient and study rows into the latest batch
FootxSchedulerPage.workflowStep4: Apply exclusions where follow-up should pause
FootxSchedulerPage.workflowStep5: Admins maintain practices, users, and access
FootxSchedulerPage.audienceBody: FootX Scheduler suits clinics and imaging workflows that depend on legacy systems but need a modern layer for reminder coordination — especially when multiple practices share operational discipline but not the same database clutter.
FootxSchedulerPage.ctaDescription: If you are evaluating reminder tooling or need help bridging legacy study data into a governed workflow, we would like to hear from you.
